Key audit matter:
Credit risk and provision for impairment loss on
loans and advances to customers
Loans and advances to customers account for a
significant portion of the Group’s total assets at 31
December 2017. The carrying value of these balances
may be materially misstated if the impairment
provision is not appropriately estimated.
How our audit addressed the key audit ma:
We assessed and tested the design and operating
effectiveness of the controls over the identification of
loans and advances that were impaired, including the
system configuration to accurately compute the number
of days past due on loans.
